name: typoscript-highlighting
description: Syntax highlighting for TypoScript files of TYPO3 in VS Code.

typoscriptHighlighting.commentRules.markdownDescription: Select the TYPO3 comment rules. **Auto** detects the version from Composer files. TYPO3 12, 13 and 14 share the modern grammar and the **TypoScript (v12+)** language mode.
enumDescriptions: Detect the TYPO3 version from composer.lock or composer.json.
Use modern comment rules (TYPO3 12 and later).
Use modern comment rules for TYPO3 13.
Use modern comment rules for TYPO3 14.

typoscriptHighlighting.colors.comments.markdownDescription: Comments and comment delimiters. Enter a `#RRGGBB` color or leave empty for **System Default** (the active theme). [Open color picker](command:typoscriptHighlighting.configureColors?%5B%22comments%22%5D) to choose from a spectrum. Changes apply immediately.
typoscriptHighlighting.colors.comments.patternErrorMessage: Use #RRGGBB, or leave empty for System Default.
